name: Conviction
long_description:
Conviction lets you create and discover trading ideas, then monitors the market and acts on them for you.

Start with any idea you have - or discover one from traders you follow on X or Reddit - and turn it into a strategy in natural language. Backtest it, paper trade it, deploy it and share what you learn.

launches.title: Conviction - Trading Desk in Your Pocket
launches.tagline: Turn ideas into trades in seconds
launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We’re Aria & Tony, co-founders of Conviction. We spent much of college experimenting with our own trading strategies. We became obsessed with one question: why should sophisticated trading tools only be accessible to Wall Street?

**TL;DR:** Describe a trading idea in natural language. Conviction tests it on historical data and deploys an AI agent that trades on your behalf.\
\
<https://youtu.be/Pdqy2_8Red8>

**The Problem**

Most people don't have time to stare at charts all day. 

But trading ideas show up everywhere: On Reddit. In the news. On X. YouTube. TikTok.

The hard part is separating signal from noise and acting in time. \
\
**Our solution**

Conviction gives everyday investors access to the kind of research, testing, and execution tools that were once built primarily for professional trading desks.

### **How it works**

1. **Start with an idea**\
   Describe a trading thesis or discover one from the market.
2. **Research it instantly**\
   Conviction pulls from SEC filings, financial news, market data, X, Truth Social, Reddit, earnings, and other signals to help you build the strategy.
3. **Test before you trade**\
   Backtest your strategy against historical market data in seconds and see how it would have performed.
4. **Try it with fake money in the real market**\
   Paper trade the strategy live before putting real capital behind it.
5. **Deploy when you are ready**\
   Connect your brokerage and put your strategy to work.
6. **Let your agent watch the market for you**\
   Your AI agent continuously monitors market data, technical indicators, news sentiment, SEC filings, earnings, social signals, and more, then acts when your conditions are met.

Institutions have always been one step ahead. Our mission is to bridge that gap and bring those tools to you.

**Start trading here:** [convictiontrade.ai](http://convictiontrade.ai)

**Questions?** Email us here: [founders@convictiontrade.ai](mailto:founders@convictiontrade.ai)

**Join our Discord** to be part of the Conviction community. Get access to exclusive offers, swag, product updates, and opportunities to help shape what we build next: <https://discord.gg/cx27rUVeF>

**Our ask:** Traders, future traders, market obsessives. Send this to your people.

launches.title: Parachute: Evaluate, Deploy, and Monitor Clinical AI
launches.tagline: We enable hospitals to adopt AI safely and at scale
launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We’re Aria & Tony, co-founders of Parachute – the end-to-end governance infrastructure that helps hospitals adopt AI safely and at scale. 

**TL;DR:** 

Parachute helps health systems evaluate, deploy, and monitor every AI tool they touch – whether it’s an Epic plug-in, vendor model, or in-house imaging model.

https://youtu.be/tRvaL0LaWOI?feature=shared

**Why we built this**

During our time spent deploying AI at Columbia University Irving Medical Center (CUIMC), we kept seeing the same issues:

* 2,000+ clinical AI tools have hit the market
* New rules (HTI-1, Colorado AI Act, CA SB 3030, White House AI Action Plan) demand auditable proof of safety, equity, and efficacy
* Lean IT teams can’t possibly vet and watch every model, and a single failure can cost lives and trigger seven-figure settlements

Great innovations die in pilot hell because the infrastructure to deploy AI tools simply does not exist.

That’s why we built Parachute and why CUIMC now uses it to track live models in real time.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfMeMr6DgcDfTSH91cRA9KtSS09A-U2M58jcX1CTXsbPw7Ud6BHvJcCpmNCjMdLr81Nsd2w887yyYtaGkNny9DtSgWATBs8qekupLkiRfuj4WlU33gbaf9u5hCBcgUypKIjh6yFlA?key=tv4NvQsH04_CHvpgP40CGw)

🪂 **How Parachute works** 

**1. Vendor discovery and vetting**\
AI agents map the hospital’s gaps and goals to the best AI tools on the market, while our review engine flags any compliance issues in vendor documentation.

**2. State-of-the-art benchmarking and evaluations**\
Our automated scoring and stress testing helps decision makers identify the best-fit options.

**3. Real-time observability**\
Once a tool is adopted, Parachute monitors it from inception through post-deployment. We automate real-time tracking of performance, drift, and bias – alerting you the moment any metric slips below threshold.

**4. Immutable audit trail**

Every approval, test, change, and runtime metric around a model is documented and audit-ready for regulators.

**Call to action**

Hospital leaders: Want stalled pilots live before 2026, access to the world’s best AI tools, an audit-proof evidence trail and hands-free monitoring? 

AI vendors: Want your product listed in the only marketplace that maps directly to hospital gaps and compliance needs?

Reach us at [founders@parachute-ai.com](mailto:founders@parachute-ai.com) or book a meeting [here](https://calendly.com/founders-parachute-ai/30min). 

For more information visit: [parachute-ai.com](http://parachute-ai.com)
